boundary_note: Bounded first pass in the complete five-engagement frozen Burnside campaign. Opening populations and replacement boundaries are unresolved. NPS and an interested retrospective history supply attributed claims only; no predictors or causal command scores are admitted.

claims.value: The frozen Union force field lists the 21st Massachusetts and 51st Pennsylvania; Woodbury’s expedition list additionally names the 9th and 89th New York and 6th New Hampshire.
claims.rationale: The abbreviated frozen field and fuller expedition list do not establish equivalent participation or headcounts. Woodbury later distinguishes reserves and attacking formations; do not turn regiment names into a numerical strength.

claims.rationale: No inspected return establishes matched opening populations. The frozen side-specific numerical bounds are blank; live zeros are not measured absence of troops. Retrospective formations, gun crews, garrisons, prisoners and troops engaged must not be interchanged.

claims.value: NPS describes destroying Dismal Swamp Canal locks to prevent ironclad transfer from Norfolk; Woodbury describes investigating enemy forces near the Albemarle and Chesapeake Canal and opportunities to obstruct it.
claims.rationale: The named canals and scope differ; preserve both accounts without treating them as interchangeable waterways or resolving the discrepancy from recollection. No original order was inspected.

claims.value: NPS assigns the expedition to Reno. Woodbury attributes an unsuccessful frontal charge to Hawkins while Reno was elsewhere in the line.
claims.rationale: Keep the historian’s attribution distinct from validated fault or motive. Named commanders and formations receive no automatic outcome credit.

citations.quote: He entrusted the operation to Brig. Gen. Jesse Lee Reno's command

claims.value: The frozen result is Inconclusive (Federals withdrew.), and live NPS says Indecisive. Woodbury instead characterizes the fight as a decisive defeat inflicted on the enemy while acknowledging Reno’s withdrawal.
claims.rationale: Preserve the interpretive dispute without recoding a victory, half-win or counterfactual effect. Retreat from the battle and achievement of the canal objective are distinct questions.

open_questions: Original orders, personnel returns, contemporary intelligence and source disputes remain deferred after the bounded shared-history follow-up. OCR has not been checked against print.
Keep opening, moving, engaged, garrison and captured populations distinct; do not use live zero displays as numerical evidence.
Broader blockade, occupation and later operations remain campaign context, not additional independent wins or automatic commander credit.
